research_notes: The Chapter 4 DLC officially contains four additional moves, including one Awoken Skill; this file does not treat the four indexed names as proof of every move's exact inventory identity or reward condition.
Dragon Spiral, Indomitable, and Venus Fist are indexed from secondary PQ reward evidence and remain partially verified until their item records and normal/Ultimate-Finish mappings are reconciled.
The Power to Overcome is separately tracked as an Awoken Skill and is not merged into PQ reward data.
Promotional videos and gameplay titles are treated as research leads rather than canonical proof of hidden conditions, drop rates, or detailed mechanics.
